_about: Network roles only. Network convenors are listed on aparn.net (About) and as Organisers on SAR’s APARN page. Event-specific organisers belong to each event in events.json. Bios are condensed from SAR’s APARN page.

people.name: Roopesh Sitharan
people.institution: Faculty of Creative Multimedia, Multimedia University (MMU), Cyberjaya
people.bio: A multidisciplinary practitioner, educator, curator, researcher and artist. His projects have appeared at the Gwangju Biennale, ISEA and SIGGRAPH, and his writing in Leonardo Electronic Almanac, CTRL+P and Documenta 12.
activity: Convenor of APARN2024, hosted at MMU

people.name: Kurniawan Adi Saputro
people.institution: Indonesian Institute of the Arts Yogyakarta (ISI Yogyakarta)
people.bio: Lecturer in the Department of Photography at ISI Yogyakarta, teaching research methods in arts and visual communication. His recent research looks at photographs in climate education, community-based festivals and climate justice. In late 2024 he built Wana Nagara, a studio around a tiny urban forest for researching culture in a time of climate crisis.
activity: Co-led the network in its first years, with Danny Butt
Convenor of APARN2023, hosted at ISI Yogyakarta
Co-developed the Climate/Coloniality residency with PRAKSIS Oslo (2025)

people.name: Danny Butt
people.institution: Victorian College of the Arts, University of Melbourne
people.bio: Coordinator of Research for Design and Production at the Victorian College of the Arts, University of Melbourne. He wrote Artistic Research in the Future Academy (Intellect / University of Chicago Press, 2017) and sits on the Editorial Board of the Journal for Artistic Research.
activity: Co-led the network in its first years, with Kurniawan Adi Saputro
Co-developed the Climate/Coloniality residency with PRAKSIS Oslo (2025)

people.name: Pornrat Damrhung
people.institution: Department of Dramatic Arts, Chulalongkorn University, Bangkok
people.bio: Professor of Dramatic Arts at Chulalongkorn University and Associate Member of the Royal Society of Thailand. She specialises in contemporary dance cultures, community performance and young people’s theatre.
activity: Took part in the first meeting (2019)
Convenor of APARN2025, hosted at Chulalongkorn University

people.name: Gunalan Nadarajan
people.institution: Penny W. Stamps School of Art and Design, University of Michigan
people.bio: An art theorist and curator working where art, science and technology meet. His publications have been translated into 16 languages. His curatorial work includes Documenta XI (Kassel, 2002) and ISEA2008 in Singapore.
activity: Opened APARN2020, as Dean of the Stamps School

firstMeeting.text: The first meeting, in October 2019, brought together Kurniawan Adi Saputro, Danny Butt, Alison Carroll, Pornrat Damrhung, Léuli Eshrāghi, Michael Hornblow, Khalid Midam and Helly Minarti, with a keynote by Gunalan Nadarajan.
